map_features.note: Southward Philippine eastern-boundary regional route from a near-surface NEC bifurcation gate at 14.3 N to an OSW southern Mindanao approach gate at 5.5 N. Excludes downstream Indonesian Throughflow, NECC and EUC routes, Mindanao and Halmahera eddy circuits, and Mindanao Undercurrent. The southern gate is an editorial regional limit, not an established whole-current endpoint.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

widths.boundary_rule: Author-reported offshore extent of equatorward mean flow, not a diagnosed pair of current boundaries. Figure 2 contours are 0.1 m/s intervals; no numerical extent threshold assigned.
widths.extraction_method: 250–300 km transcribed from p.38 prose after inspecting Figure 2a; no edge digitization, midpoint or route buffer.
widths.geographic_scope: Oblique mean line from 8.16 N, 126.61 E to 8.77 N, 130 E off Mindanao. Profiles within 80 km were projected and objectively mapped; not an along-current envelope.
widths.layer: Surface expression of averaged absolute geostrophic equatorward flow. The 0–1000 m glider velocity reference is not a fixed measurement layer for this extent.

mean_offshore_context.source_date_discrepancy: p.35 describes intended repeated sections June 2009–January 2014; p.36 reports deployments June 2009–July 2014. Neither supplies exact profiles entering Figure 2.

widths.name: Mindanao Current
widths.range_interpretation: Approximate range in the author’s prose description of one averaged surface section; not uncertainty, seasonal extrema or a paired-boundary full width.

widths.section_orientation: Oblique mean line; reported offshore distance retained without converting it to paired cross-flow edges.

widths.source_locator: Printed p.38 / PDF p.6, Velocity and Transport, glider paragraph and Figure 2a; mean-line sampling described on pp.36–37 / PDF pp.4–5.
widths.time_convention: Spatial and temporal mean of glider profiles; campaign context June 2009–July 2014. Exact contributing dates of the Figure 2 mean unresolved.
